correctness.rationale: The metric equivalence is exact for cardinality five. Five pure vectors plus five shifts are 10 valid words. The explicit 5+20+20 forbidden-pair cliques, their 17-member C-case finite matrix, and complete seven-type incidence counts verify an exact fractional clique cover of total weight 10. A standalone enumerator confirms all finite premises over 126 vectors, and the proof establishes the weighted-independent-set inequality without extrapolation.
